name: g7 clickhouse — QueryEvent (ClickHouse, FILTER avgLatencyMs) ⋈ Document (ArangoDB, OPTIONAL filename) on accountId
sparql: PREFIX c: <urn:arango-sparql:concept#> SELECT ?feature ?avgLatencyMs ?source ?filename WHERE { ?e a c:QueryEvent ; c:feature ?feature ; c:avgLatencyMs ?avgLatencyMs ; c:accountId ?acct . ?d a c:Document ; c:source ?source ; c:accountId ?acct . FILTER(?avgLatencyMs < 25) OPTIONAL { ?d c:filename ?filename } }
